name: ppmr-read
why: MRC c15,c2,4 (ARM1176 peripheral port remap) does not exist on ARM11 MPCore -> mov r3,#0

name: ppmr-write
why: MCR c15,c2,4 in the vector-page reset path -> nop

name: uart-tx-data
why: S5L UART transmit: ldr pc,=shim_putc (log ring read by the ARM9)

name: uart-rx-data
why: S5L UART receive: mov r0,#0; bx lr

name: rtc-wait-0s
why: AppleARMPE::getGMTTimeOfDay waits 30 s for an RTC that doesn't exist yet (PMU/MCU driver TODO): timeout 0

name: iic-device-transfer
why: AppleARMIICDevice transfer (vtable slot 0x35c: op, sub-address, data) -> shim_iic_transfer: a register file per I2C device instead of a bus that does not exist (Thumb: nop; bx pc; nop; ARM: ldr pc,[pc,#-4]; .word)

name: i2s-start-no-lrck-sync
why: AppleS5L8900XI2SController DMA start (5H11a 0xc0612b60, state at +0x8c): start in state 3 (synced) instead of 1 so it does not wait for GPIO 44 edges (see 4.2.1 0x8066d490). Needs the shim's audio IRQ glue to enter this kernel's IRQ path (audio_glue.S, re-log 130)

name: uart-init
why: 5H11a S5L UART init: return at once (tx/rx go to the shim)

name: timer-get-abstime
why: 5H11a cpu_data timer hook: 64-bit timebase from the MPCore watchdog

name: timer-get-decrementer
why: 5H11a timer hook: MPCore private timer counter

name: timer-set-decrementer
why: 5H11a timer hook: arm the MPCore private timer

name: cs-invalid-page-allow
why: 5H11a cs_invalid_page (Thumb, called from vm_fault_enter at 0xc003c50e for a tainted page or an executable page without a validated hash) -> return 0 (movs r0,#0; bx lr). The page is mapped and the process is neither killed (CS_KILL) nor refused (CS_HARD), so byte-patched Apple dylibs keep their stock signature blob and still load (the blob itself stays valid; only the patched pages miss their hash). Re-log 116 showed that re-signing breaks dyld and that patched pages killed SpringBoard; this is the 2.x equivalent of the cs_enforcement_disable boot-arg, which xnu-1228 does not have.

name: s5l-perf-nowait
why: AppleS5L8720XClockController: after starting a performance-state change it sleeps on its command gate until byte +0x248 is cleared by the change-done interrupt, which the fake clock/power page never raises (the 8C148 s5l-perf-nowait, +0x38c there). Every display sleep (Lock) lowers the performance state, so the CLCD power path blocked here and Home never turned the display back on (re-log 128/129). ldrb r3,[rX,#0x248]; cmp r3,#0; bne wait -> mov r3,#0; strb r3,[rX,#0x248]; nop

name: audio-pm-msg-no-store
why: AppleEmbeddedAudio's IOPMrootDomain interest handler (ARM, 0xc03efb08) stores 0 to messageArgument+4 (IOPowerStateChangeNotification.returnValue) for every message before it checks the type. publishFeature() (from IOPMrootDomain::batteryPublished, when an IOPMPowerSource registers) sends kIOPMMessageFeatureChange with the root domain itself as the argument, so the store zeroed IOPMrootDomain's retain count; the next registry iterator release freed it ('IOPMrootDomain: attached at free()', re-log 132; QEMU watchpoint on rootDomain+4). The senders of the sleep messages pre-zero returnValue, so the store is dropped (mov r4,r2 kept; str r0,[r6,#4] -> nop)
